semantics.name: bold_percent_change
semantics.established: D cell11 consumes precomputed calccontrol MNI152 desc-fmriprep BOLD_percchange maps. A cell19 forms each voxel baseline median over control frames, computes temporal percent signal change, then median across calc frames. C cell8 PLS-input BOLD uses a distinct scalar baseline median without axis across masked voxels and time. These must not be silently treated as identical.

semantics.name: fig2b_order
semantics.established: For each positive/negative group mask, take median across subjects independently per voxel, then nanmedian across voxels. D separately retains per-subject nanmedian across voxels; median of those summaries is distinct.

semantics.name: calibration
semantics.established: A cell5 CBF_upscaled=CBF/0.75; CaO2=0.334*Hct*55.6*O2sat/100; CMRO2=CBF_upscaled*OEF*CaO2/100. CBF common scaling cancels from paired percent change.

semantics.name: spatial_inference
semantics.established: No geometry-preserving spatial null was established in inspected primary sources. PLS resampling and source participant summary uncertainty do not establish spatial independence. A spatial correlation coefficient can be descriptive; spatial p-values require a separately frozen scientifically validated null.
